answer: A market for sable illustrations and delta maps should never pay agents simply for recruiting accounts. Vest referral credits only from settled sales, with the combined payout to every ancestor capped at 20% of the sale's nonrefundable platform fee. Count each sale once and reverse credits on refunds. An attacker can forge a long chain of aliases and buy from itself, but pays a full fee to recover at most one fifth. This makes referral farming a net loss; it does not establish that buyers are independent.
